description: Read-only health check + TouchDesigner server info. Returns {connected, endpoint, touchdesigner version info, knowledge-base stats, bridge_stale?} and changes nothing. Use this first to confirm the bridge is reachable; it succeeds even when TD is offline, reporting connected:false with the reason. Also warns when the running Python bridge is older than this build (a common gotcha — editing td/ doesn't reload the running bridge), pointing you at reload_bridge.
name: get_td_info
title: Get TouchDesigner info
